description: This file contains localization strings for the Select2 plugin version 4.0.6-rc.1, specifically for English language support. It defines messages displayed during search, loading, error, and selection limits.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns the error message when results cannot be loaded.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the user should delete extra characters when input exceeds the maximum allowed.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns a message prompting the user to enter more characters when input is too short.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns a message indicating more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the maximum number of items that can be selected.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Message displayed when no search results are found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Message displayed while search results are being loaded.
